fusions.name: Pounce and Pin
fusions.desc: You spring up to 6 tiles onto the target and pin it under your mesh, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snap and Hop
fusions.desc: Snaps a mesh shut around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and you move 20% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Tangled Landing
fusions.desc: You leap 4 tiles and land with a mesh flung out around you: every creature within 3 tiles is held in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Next Host Over
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your mesh leaps off the body to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
